parameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit Image1 into ONE independently drawn 1254x1254 transparent RGBA game sprite. Image1 is the edit target and exact composition; Image2 is same-direction leg/stance continuity only, never copy its pose; Image3 is identity/hand ownership; Image4 is the approved bright rounded clean Daoist chibi hand-painted finish. Preserve Image1 head position and size, face, hair, ribbons, torso, sleeves, qin and hands. LEFT hand supports upper qin, RIGHT hand lower strings; no hand swap. Redraw ONLY lower trousers, hips-to-knees as needed, calves, ankles and boots to show the stated weight-bearing position. Keep camera and canvas fixed; no zoom, no global movement, no recentering, no mirrored image, no deformation/duplication. Two legs and two boots only, both anatomically joined. The supporting leg must visibly carry the pelvis with natural knee flexion and a real planted shoe/forefoot; not merely a low floating tip. The other leg swings naturally and stays free. Knee, ankle, heel-to-toe axis remain along travel, never outward. This is a continuous grounded run cycle, RIGHT supports target01–08, LEFT supports09–16. Four consecutive positions per leg: forward contact, early body passing, beneath-to-behind late load, rear forefoot push; two different poses at each position. Preserve genuine alpha/translucency; no painted floor, shadow, motion streak, border, letters or effects. DIRECTION S: straight front view running toward viewer/downscreen. RIGHT leg is screen LEFT, LEFT leg screen RIGHT. Both boots' long axes point straight toward the camera/downscreen, parallel, never splay sideways. A planted boot shows its upper/front and a thin horizontal sole rim, not a large bottom face. Rearward position is deeper in the scene/slightly higher in screen relative to pelvis, NOT sideways. Keep native source root[627,1215], upper-body coordinates and natural perspective. TARGET S06 is SECOND late-load pose: anatomical RIGHT supporting leg trails a LITTLE behind the hip along the travel axis, knee extends more than first late-load but remains soft. Forefoot stays firmly down and heel just starts a SMALL lift, with an uninterrupted weight-bearing leg. Pelvis travels over/ahead of the stance ankle. LEFT knee is further forward and swinging; its foot remains airborne. Do not make the same pose as first late-load, and do not put both feet in air. CRITICAL: Start from this already planted source pose. Keep its support foot at the SAME depth/contact band near native y1215 (allow only natural perspective for a small rearward shift), and keep the same leg supporting. Both new lower-body poses must stay weight-bearing, not lift the entire boot. SCREEN-LEFT leg is the supporting RIGHT leg. SCREEN-RIGHT leg is the free LEFT swing.
